scope: Local H2 unit and integration suites, actual corporate Tenant/Package/Menu/AdminUser/Role/Permission provisioning, actual AuthController HTTP login and OAuth services/Redis DAO, actual CRM/permissions/MVC joint journey, encrypted credential delivery, HMAC and state machine, isolated Springdoc, existing login/OAuth regression. KnowDo and peripheral services are explicit doubles; Redis protocol uses isolated jedis-mock; joint permission caches use ConcurrentMapCacheManager. No production or real KnowDo/WeChat calls. File-backed H2 cold-process restart tests force-terminate a child JVM at three boundaries and resume in a separate JVM, using real local MGS provisioning and a separately persisted KnowDo fixture. Opt-in Playwright browser login and Agent HTTP write/read-back through ephemeral loopback Tomcat, with production timestamp serializer and actual menu migration. Actual signed tool HTTP request-advice/JSON/validation/controller/local-service chain via MockMvc, including secure-request enforcement and unchanged maintenance when new enrollment is disabled.
limitations: Corporate bootstrap now covers actual Tenant/Package/Menu/AdminUser/Role/Permission services on H2; config, department/post, MQ and CRM/OAuth boundaries remain doubles. MySQL and deployed initialization are unverified.
Ordinary account creation uses actual user, role and permission services; its tenant/menu/CRM/OAuth boundaries remain doubles.
OAuth validation and system permission directory are fixture boundaries in the separate CRM MVC tests.
Export/file denial is verified before sentinel MVC handlers, not against actual object storage.
KnowDo binding credential forwarding/replay/expiry and WeChat end-to-end are not verified.

Actual browser-to-isolated-Tomcat login, Agent write/read-back and two-account isolation now pass. MySQL, real KnowDo safe cards, WeChat, host/power loss and deployed restart/network fault exercises remain unverified.
frontendEvidence: frontend-test-evidence.json: 5 fixture scenarios; browser-live-test-evidence.json: 2 actual isolated-backend browser contexts within the single TrialBrowserJourneyTest, not two additional backend tests.
